jobs.name: 宁红夜 / Viper Ning
jobs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / background-extraction. Edit the supplied official NARAKA character artwork into ONE crisp high-resolution transparent desktop UI character cutout. Preserve the recognizable character's face, hair, outfit, colors, weapon design and premium semi-realistic 3D game rendering. Only the character holding the weapon is visible. Remove ALL surrounding ink brush strokes, smoke, flames, particles, glow, abstract shapes, scenery and other backdrop. No circle, no frame, no disc, no base, no shadow on a floor, no ground, no text or logo. Genuine transparent alpha outside silhouette, including gaps between limbs and weapon. Portrait 1024x1536 or comparable high-resolution. Tight centered three-quarter-body composition from head to mid-thigh, face large enough to remain recognizable when reduced to 116px; keep the whole head and visible held weapon within canvas, with small 4% transparent margin. Relocate sword tip only if needed to fit, do not use a huge horizontal poster canvas. Sharp clean antialiased silhouette and detailed face, fabric and metal; no pixelated brush texture. No extra objects or magic effects.
Character: 宁红夜 / Viper Ning. Keep the red blindfold, black high ponytail, crimson costume and curved sword. Her hand must visibly grip the sword.
